description: Secure modern cloud infrastructure and become a cloud security specialist.

phases.title: Phase 1: Cloud & IT Foundations (Weeks 1–4)
items: Cloud Basics — AWS/Azure/GCP free tier (pick one to start)
Identity & Access Management (IAM) basics — AWS IAM tutorial
Build 1 project: Launch a free-tier VM and secure it

phases.title: Phase 2: Cloud Security Core (Weeks 5–8)
items: Cloud Security Posture Management — intro to tools like Prowler
Build 1 project: Audit a misconfigured cloud lab environment

phases.title: Phase 3: Cloud Security Career (Weeks 9–12)
items: Study for AWS Security Specialty or Azure Security Engineer
Learn Cloud SIEM — AWS GuardDuty / Azure Sentinel
Build a portfolio: 2 cloud security projects + writeups
